verse.verse_1: By the sky with its constellations,
verse.verse_3: by the Witness and the witnessed,
verse.verse_4: destroyed were the people of the trench,
verse.verse_5: the makers of the fuel-stoked fire!
verse.verse_7: to watch what they were doing to the believers,
verse.verse_8: whom they hated for no other reason than that they believed in God, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy,
verse.verse_9: to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. God is witness over all things.
verse.verse_10: Those who persecute the believing men and believing women, and then do not repent, will surely suffer the punishment of Hell, and the torment of burning.
verse.verse_11: But those who believe and do good deeds shall be rewarded with gardens watered by flowing rivers. That is the supreme triumph.
verse.verse_12: The grip of your Lord is indeed severe,
verse.verse_13: it is He who begins and repeats [His creation],
verse.verse_14: and He is the Forgiving and Loving One.
verse.verse_15: The Lord of the Glorious Throne,
verse.verse_17: Have you not heard the story of the hosts
verse.verse_19: Yet those who deny the truth persist in denial.
verse.verse_20: God encompasses them from all sides.
verse.verse_21: It is indeed a glorious Quran,
